text: the Sensitive Price Indicator fell 0.65% in the week ended 19 November and stands 10.41% higher year on year; wheat flour is up 44.20% on the year, while tomatoes fell 30.55% in the week.
the ECC amended EXIM Bank's Long-Term Export Growth Financing Facility, lowering the minimum export threshold for SMEs from 80% to 50% within four years, with a review after six months.
Alireza Firouzja won the final on an Armageddon decider against Anish Giri after coming back from a set down; Fabiano Caruana took third ahead of Maxime Vachier-Lagrave.

AWS reports that attackers' AI agents went from mapping a medical imaging AI app's API to writing files on its server in about 11 minutes, through an unpatched flaw in the open-source MONAI Label; a fix and an advisory are now out.
CVE-2026-123890, rated CVSS 9.8, was exploited as a zero-day before the patch; fixed builds are 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 and 8.0 U3m, and no workaround is listed.
tourist arrivals passed 2 million on 20 November, the third straight year past the mark, after 17 November in 2025 and 26 December in 2024.
sources: AWS Security Blog · The Register · FIDE · Chess.com · Pakistan Bureau of Statistics · Dawn · Business Recorder · Xinhua · Daily Mirror (Sri Lanka)
